Hi Ben,

We're ready to finalize the 2x capacity top-up with Redwood for Q4. As a heads up, our finance team is moving invoicing to a centralized AP team (AuroraCloud Finance). We'll need a PO for the commitment and the invoice sent to finance@auroracloud.com. Can you confirm:

- The total committed monthly spend and billing entity on the invoice (do we bill AuroraCloud, Inc. or AuroraCloud EU?)
- Whether we can switch to net45 terms for this renewal
- A copy of Redwood's W-9

I've attached the draft PO our procurement team will send once we confirm details.

Thanks,

Elaine
Procurement Lead
AuroraCloud

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-04-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Commitment increase & invoicing point-of-contact transfer

Hi Elaine—great to hear.

Quick answers:
- Billing entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. (US entity). If you require EU invoicing we can route through our EU entity but that requires an alternate legal addendum—please confirm.
- Net terms: we can accept net45 for committed Dedicated contracts > $100k ARR; for this top-up we'll need an amendment to the MSA. I'll loop in Marissa from finance/contracting to scope the amendment.
- W-9: attached.

Next steps I propose:
1) I sign the PO once procurement confirms Aurora's payor entity (AuroraCloud, Inc.).
2) Marissa will issue a one-page addendum approving net45 and the updated commitment schedule.
3) Monica (billing ops) will handle invoice routing and remittance instructions.

Attached: Signed_SOW_Aurora_20270401.pdf, Redwood_W9_20270401.pdf

Best,
Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
